notes: Two routes to the same saying: the book reading («قرأ في أصل») of إسماعيل بن عياش, and his son محمد's route through «حدثني أبي» (a relation); both meet at ضمضم, written once, so ضمضم onward is the shared tail
The reading from the shaykh's book is read as a transmission link; the man who asks inside Amr's story is in the scene only
